input.standard: ASTM E741 (tracer gas concentration decay, single zone); ASTM D6245 (occupant CO2 as tracer)
input.purpose: Measure the volume of air V_lab served by scrubber-1-t2 as V = Qe * tau, from a CO2 rise at reduced speed and a decay at full speed, occupants as source.

monitoring.reason: The three occupants of the lab breathe the CO2 raised by the test; FE-3 is in hab-b, the hatch stays closed, and one more person entering the lab is caught by the vitals abort.

steps.why: Rise: reduce effective flow so lab CO2 climbs several hundred ppm above the start (1100 ppm) toward a higher equilibrium; hatch held closed.
Decay: full speed, record the return toward the full-speed equilibrium; about one time constant (first guess V=30 m3, Qe=1 m3/min, tau=30 min); hatch still closed.

abort.source: scrubber.motor.state: CO2 of the lab volume
abort.when: CO2 at or above limits.co2AbortPpm (3000 ppm)
the device refuses a step's command
a monitored person leaves 45-120 bpm, monitoring is lost, or one more person enters the lab

expected.start: Lab CO2 about 1100 ppm, near the full-speed equilibrium: 3 occupants x 0.38 L/min = 1.14 L/min over Qe 1 m3/min gives about +1140 ppm.
expected.rise: At 40 percent (Qe about 0.4 m3/min) the equilibrium is about 2850 ppm, tau about 75 min for V=30 m3; after 25 min the CO2 should be about 1600 ppm (rise of about 500 ppm), well under 2500. Rise slower than this means a larger V.
expected.decay: At full speed it should relax toward about 1140 ppm with tau = V/Qe (about 30 min for V=30 m3; scrubber lag 3.33 min). Fit C(t)=C_eq+(C_0-C_eq)exp(-t/tau) towards C_eq; V_lab = Qe*tau, with Qe from the datasheet (1 m3/min).
expected.hypotheses_fail: The hypotheses fail if the fit does not converge to an equilibrium near 1140 ppm, if the residuals are not white (not well mixed), if hab-b CO2 moves in step with the lab (the closed hatch exchanges air), or if a step command is refused. Then V_lab is not valid.
expected.result: V_lab in the fitted range 10 to 200 m3; default guess 30 m3.

hypotheses: The lab is one well-mixed zone.

The hatch (hatch-1-t2) is held closed in both steps and the exchange through it is not measured; hab-b CO2 is recorded to show whether it exchanges air (design flow when closed 3 m3/min in station-topology, unverified).
Occupants stay 3 in the lab at constant awake activity (0.38 L/min each, 0.26 to 0.45) during the whole test.
Scrubber effective flow scales with speed from the datasheet effective flow at full (1 m3/min); the lag (3.33 min) is short against tau.
Outdoor/background CO2 and the sensor's calibration are not measured; the fit towards C_eq removes their offset.
The first guess V=30 m3 only sizes the durations; it is not a result.
